targets.label: codebuddy

rule_descriptions.common-agents: Use when coordinating agents or subagent work in this repository.
rule_descriptions.common-code-review: Use when reviewing a diff, PR, or proposed change.
rule_descriptions.common-coding-style: Use when writing or reviewing code in any language.
rule_descriptions.common-constraints: Always apply: project constraints, frozen surfaces, and gate rules.
rule_descriptions.common-development-workflow: Use when planning, sequencing, or landing a change.
rule_descriptions.common-docker: Use when editing container, network, or deployment configuration.
rule_descriptions.common-edit-safety: Use before editing files or running destructive shell or git commands.
rule_descriptions.common-hooks: Use when editing hooks or lifecycle callbacks.
rule_descriptions.common-lesson-memory: Use when recording a decision, pitfall, or lesson.
rule_descriptions.common-patterns: Use when choosing implementation patterns or abstractions.
rule_descriptions.common-performance: Use when a change touches hot paths, allocations, or performance.
rule_descriptions.common-security: Always apply: security boundaries, unsafe or FFI code, and untrusted input.
rule_descriptions.common-testing: Use when adding or changing tests, or when behavior has no regression guard.
rule_descriptions.rust-coding-style: Use when writing or reviewing Rust code.
rule_descriptions.rust-hooks: Use when editing Rust lifecycle hooks or callbacks.
rule_descriptions.rust-patterns: Use when selecting Rust ownership, error, or iterator patterns.
rule_descriptions.rust-security: Use when Rust code touches unsafe, FFI, or untrusted input.
rule_descriptions.rust-testing: Use when adding or changing Rust tests.

targets.notes: CodeBuddy pilot: generated RULE.mdc rules and skills links; MCP reuses the root .mcp.json produced by the project target.
